rule.name: UnsafeStopFlag
rule.message: This boolean flag is polled in the loop of run() or call() and set from another method, but it is neither volatile nor guarded by one lock. Without a happens-before edge the JIT may read it once and keep it in a register, so the loop never sees the write and the shutdown hangs or the worker spins forever; the class compiles and passes on a fast machine. Declare it volatile (private volatile boolean running = true), use an AtomicBoolean, or read and write it under the same lock. An exception fits a flag that is written only after the thread has stopped, or one that is confined to a single thread by design.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $loops := ('run', 'call', 'doRun', 'runLoop', 'loop'), $guarded := function($node) { exists($node/ancestor::SynchronizedStatement) or exists($node/ancestor::MethodDeclaration[1][ModifierList/@ExplicitModifiers = 'synchronized']) }, $isField := function($n, $name) { exists($n[self::VariableAccess[@Name = $name] | self::FieldAccess[@Name = $name][*[1][self::ThisExpression]]]) } return //ClassDeclaration[ExtendsList/ClassType[@SimpleName = 'Thread'] or ImplementsList/ClassType[@SimpleName = ('Runnable', 'Callable')]] /ClassBody/FieldDeclaration[PrimitiveType[@Kind = 'boolean']] [not(ModifierList/@ExplicitModifiers = ('volatile', 'final'))] /VariableDeclarator [let $name := @Name, $class := ancestor::ClassDeclaration[1], $readers := $class/ClassBody/MethodDeclaration[@Name = $loops][empty(.//VariableId[@Name = $name])], $conditions := $readers/(.//WhileStatement/*[1] | .//DoStatement/*[last()] | .//ForStatement/*[not(self::ForInit or self::ForUpdate or self::Block or ends-with(local-name(), 'Statement'))][1] | .//*[self::WhileStatement or self::DoStatement or self::ForStatement]/Block/IfStatement [*[2][self::BreakStatement or self::ReturnStatement or self::Block/*[self::BreakStatement or self::ReturnStatement]]]/*[1]), $reads := $conditions/descendant-or-self::*[self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess] [$isField(., $name)], $writes := $class/ClassBody//AssignmentExpression[$isField(*[1], $name)] [let $method := ancestor::MethodDeclaration[1] return exists($method) and empty($method//VariableId[@Name = $name]) and not(some $r in $readers satisfies $r is $method)] return exists($reads) and exists($writes) and (some $access in ($reads, $writes) satisfies not($guarded($access)))]
